correctness.rationale: For any t<=q, fewer than N points lie on the faulty lines and fewer than N lines pass through faulty point endpoints; hence intact universal witnesses exist on both shores. These witnesses give connectedness, conical pure-side radius-two complexes and a radius-three global cone. Girth six makes the two-cone cover intersect exactly in the faulted graph, yielding a natural suspension and integral cycle lattice isomorphism. Euler cycle ranks give q^3-t, naturality and coordinate projection give primitive maps, and simply connected relative quotients plus Whitehead give wedge cofibers. Boundary cases t=0 and t=q included; t=q+1 cannot guarantee connectivity. The package verifier exhaustively checks all 232 and 23,479 admissible fault subsets at q=2,3, and independent F2 homology for sampled configurations.

value.rationale: The uniform fault budget t<=q is the largest possible that guarantees connectivity for every placement of failed incidence edges in any projective plane. The finding certifies complete integral Rips barcodes and primitive inclusion maps independent of fault geometry, despite large and configuration-dependent simplex changes; it improves beyond previously handled intact, vertex, star-fault and low-order examples. This is a natural worst-case robustness theorem, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
